scope: Resolve ODA's one-based flag numbering and restore the generic R2007+ TABLE payload-presence rule; AC1021 checksum values need no key-specific exception.

authority.specification: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.rule: For R2007 and later, ODA uses one-based bit names: bit 1 (mask 0x01) marks kGeneral and suppresses its type-specific variant; setting only mask 0x02 does not suppress the variant.

ac1021Sample.artifactPolicy: Inspected in place; not copied into or committed to this repository.

checksumCustomData.evidenceCeiling: Confirms a physical flags=2/type=2 payload. Its custom key records source lineage; ODA's mask-0x01 rule already permits this payload generically.

nativeStringCarrier.evidenceCeiling: Retained only as the previously source-bounded AC1021 string profile. It is not generalized to other TABLE profiles or versions.

behavior: DRW_CadValue::hasDwgPayload suppresses only mask 0x01, following ODA's one-based bit numbering.
The AC1021 flags=4/6 type=4 native-string profile retains its distinct source-backed body decoding.
AC1021 flags=2/type=2 custom values use the generic present-payload rule; the exact key preserves lineage without changing parser semantics.
Generated AC1021 and AC1024 vectors exercise flags 0 through 3 and preserve following-unit/string/table boundaries.

validation.results: The core, DWG object-vector, TABLE DXF and dwg2dxf targets rebuilt. Both CadValue selectors, the complete DWG object-vector executable and both TABLE DXF selectors passed. The refreshed AC1027 conversion still fails closed at TABLECONTENT 0xC94; no full test suite was run.
validation.fixturePolicy: No DWG/DXF fixture files were added; controls are generated from scratch at runtime.
